PRODUCT_NAME: 8" ECO Funnel with 70mm Samson Stacker® cap adapter
DESCRIPTION:
8" ECO Funnel with 70mm Samson Stacker® cap adapter.

This 8" ECO Funnel® is designed to fit a 20 liter (5 gallon) Rectangular Samson Stacker® Drum with a 70mm 6TPI closure. Our patented funnel design features a latching lid with gasket to keep fumes contained. A removable large particle filter catches stir bars or other items. A detachable tube extends into the waste container to minimize chemical evaporation. The 8" version of our ECO Funnel includes an additional safety feature to prevent over-filling; a secondary air-lock tube creates a small air gap in your waste container, which causes fluid to back up temporarily into the funnel when the container is full. After the screw cap adapter is loosened, the remaining fluid will safely flow into the container and not spill.

Benefits of ECO Funnel®

  • Solves the "open waste container" problem.
  • Prevents emissions of 99.9% of volatile waste solvents, acids, and bases in the laboratory.
  • Has a unique, patented design that meets most local, state and federal safety regulations and requirements.
  • May be used again and again and resists nearly all corrosive chemicals.
  • Is considered a state of the art product by environmental health and safety officers and industry professionals.

The ECO Funnel is the ultimate lab safety product for collection of hazardous liquid waste. Its unique, patented design performs two functions, acting as both a sealed waste container and also as a solvent funnel. The 8" ECO Funnel® is made of HDPE and has a 2 liter fluid capacity. This solvent waste funnel is designed with a custom screw cap which secures it to a specified waste container. It also features a closed-cell HDPE gasket inside the lid and a sturdy positive latch which ensures the lid remains securely closed. A removable filter is also built into the interior to reduce the loss of stir bars or other large particles in the waste liquid. The ECO Funnel is a pass-through system, meaning chemicals are not sitting in the funnel for any length of time, so its HDPE construction is compatible with most solvents including those that need to be stored in glass. Check Chemical Compatibility with HDPE.

ECO Funnel FAQ

Does the ECO Funnel® comply with regulations for emissions from open waste containers?
Yes. The primary function of the ECO Funnel is to reduce the emission of volatile solvents to near zero, while providing a convenient way to handle temporary waste in the lab.

Are there any chemicals that should be avoided when using the ECO Funnel®?
Yes, you should avoid strong acids, bases and oxidizers that can jeopardize HDPE.

Can the ECO Funnel® be kept on the waste bottle 24 hrs a day?
We recommend that the ECO Funnel be removed from a waste container when not in use, just like any other funnel. They are for the collection of temporary waste only. Waste should be frequently transferred to a more permanent waste container for optimum safety.

Read all our ECO Funnel FAQ

Please note: A new version of this ECO Funnel® is available. Please order: EF2-3004C

Segregate your waste streams with color-coded ECO Funnels. Every organization has its own color-coding rules and systems in place, but proper segregation of hazardous waste is required for all laboratories. One popular way to color-code chemicals is described to the right. You can use our four lid colors to keep certain waste streams separate. Common chemical waste disposal rules to follow:

  • Segregate acids from bases
  • Segregate oxidizers from organic solvents
  • Segregate flammable liquids from acids, bases, oxidizers
  • Segregate corrosives acids from flammables, bases, oxidizers
  • Segregate corrosive bases from oxidizers and acids
  • Segregate water-reactive from aqueous solutions and oxidizers

Red = flammables
Blue = toxic (chloroform, cyanide, heavy metals) or corrosive and/or aqueous
Yellow = reactive
Green - General low hazard chemicals or oxidizing agents
